title: Reader Chapter 8
hook: A reader-facing chapter under phase-1 review.

breakdown.fullRead: The AND/BOTH version gives the self-image more structure. Laura can write, "I am a strong analyst and this model may contain an error and I can use the review without becoming incompetent." Henrik can tell himself, "I love my daughter and I sometimes have effects that hurt her and I can listen without making her comfort me." Isabel can write, "This relationship is in trouble tonight and I am still worthy of love." These sentences are not decoration. They are load-bearing beams.
